title: Restart the Babyface Pro USB session after a coalesced STOP/START
problem: A rapid ALSA STOP then START can be coalesced into one asynchronous work run. The worker sees users > 0 and streaming == true, skips both branches, and leaves the proprietary RME session silent although ALSA reports it running.
reproduce: At the pinned baseline, model a running stream whose user count crosses zero and returns to one before stream_work executes. No state records the zero crossing, so the worker performs no hardware action.
acceptance: The zero crossing remains pending until consumed by stream_work; the coalesced case kills and fully starts the session, while ordinary start, stop, and unchanged-running cases preserve their actions.
repair: Record a restart_pending flag whenever stream_users reaches zero. The worker atomically consumes it, kills any still-live URBs, and then follows the existing full cold-init/session-start path when users are present.

verification.limitations: BCL verifies the exact source wiring and five lifecycle transitions. The changed module also builds against Ubuntu Linux 7.0 headers; audible recovery still requires the reporter’s Babyface Pro FS.
verification.ownerCheck: Install the patched DKMS module, start full-duplex playback/capture through PipeWire, change Bitwig buffer 1024 -> 2048 -> 512, and confirm audio resumes in both directions after every change without reloading or replugging.
